feature_contract.goal: Connect genuine D3D9 SM3 shader-local Boolean control flow into native D3D11 game VS/PS Draw/DrawIndexed while preserving full-frame output and fail-closed D3D9 input/render fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Translate shader-owned DEFB and nested IF/ELSE/ENDIF to native VS/PS HLSL on existing real game Draw/DrawIndexed path.
Reject undefined live BOOL b registers, duplicate/invalid DEFB, unsafe operand flags and incomplete branch writes; preserve original D3D9 game draw/input.
C++ bool codegen and nested definite-write probes, source checks, and mandatory five CI workflows pass at one exact source SHA.

integration_path: Intercept real D3D9 shader VS/PS bytecode on existing Draw callsites
Decode shader-local DEFB and conditional IF/ELSE/ENDIF with branch-aware register proofs
Emit HLSL static BOOLs and branch flow into existing D3D11 native full-frame Draw/DrawIndexed
Reject dynamic bool without source-game snapshot, maintain original D3D9 render/input/FFB

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: Portable C++ DEFB true/false HLSL and nested definite-write mask probe, real SM3 native backend hookup.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Out-of-range and noncanonical BOOL, live b# without DEFB, invalid operand modifiers and incomplete branches fail closed.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: Live game SM3 bytecode -> native shader-owned boolean IF HLSL -> D3D11 draw with DX9Ex safe fallback.
